questions.question: Identify one social reform movement in 19th-century India that / influenced marriage practices.
questions.solution_html:
• Social Reform Movement: The Brahmo Samaj, led by Raja Ram Mohan Roy
  • reformed marriage practices by opposing child marriage and promoting widow
  • remarriage.
questions.final_answer: remarriage
